_finding: The guard is what stands between an agent and a fake stock token. It must refuse when it could not check (failing open would let every trade through during an outage), refuse an impostor, and refuse a listed token of a different stock from the one asked for. Owner, 25.11: the server is the one point every verdict passes through, so the guard does not take its word: a listed Base address must have the issuer's pinned form, and by default the issuer's own list, read by the guard itself and chosen by the chain, must have it.
